meta.name: Vũ Hoàng Diệu Trung
meta.summary: Software Engineer with over 4 years of experience in web development and internal business systems. Experienced with ASP.NET Core, C#, Vue, React, Next.js, PHP/WordPress, and SQL database management systems. Has developed ERP systems and applications for digitizing internal processes, with a solid background in IT support, networking, and system troubleshooting. Capable of working end to end, from requirements analysis and feature development to maintenance and user support.

skills.title: Frontend Development
description: Core: HTML5, CSS3, SASS, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Responsive Web Design.
Frameworks/Libraries: React, Next.js, Vue, jQuery (AJAX), Bootstrap 5, Tailwind CSS, Ant Design, Shadcn UI, Payload CMS.
Design tools: Figma, Photoshop.
Version control: Git.

skills.title: Backend & Database Development
description: Languages/Frameworks: C# (ASP.NET Core), PHP (Laravel, WordPress), Java, Python.
ORM: Entity Framework Core, Prisma ORM.
Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MSSQL, Oracle.
SQL (DDL, DML, DCL, TCL), procedural programming (PL/SQL, T-SQL).
RESTful API, HTTP protocol, JWT.
Docker, Docker Compose (basic knowledge). CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI.
Other tools: Postman.

skills.title: IT Support Skills
description: Operating systems: Windows, Linux (installation, configuration, troubleshooting).
Networking (basic): TCP/IP, IP addressing, subnet mask, DNS, DHCP, VLAN; configuring routers, switches, LAN/Wi-Fi networks; diagnosing network issues with ping, tracert, ipconfig/ifconfig, nslookup.
Microsoft Office, Google Workspace.
Troubleshooting hardware, software, operating system, and network issues.
Remote support tools: TeamViewer, AnyDesk, Remote Desktop.
Data security, antivirus software, firewalls.
Website hosting support and domain pointing (DNS records).

skills.title: Soft Skills
description: Effective teamwork and good coordination between Frontend, Backend, and UI/UX teams.
Fast self-learner (self-taught ASP.NET Core and Next.js, and built full-stack applications).
Time management and regular progress reporting.

accomplishments: Developed and maintained internal web applications using ASP.NET Core, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to support the company's digital transformation projects.
Built user interfaces and interactive features to improve usability and workflow efficiency for internal staff.
Implemented CRUD operations and business logic layers to handle data for internal digitalization systems.
Worked directly with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into software features.
Continuously supported and updated internal applications based on user feedback and changes in business processes.
Developed and maintained the interfaces of ERP business modules using Vue and Ant Design.
Integrated REST APIs with the backend, and handled data entry, search, filtering, and data management flows.
Worked closely with the Backend team to design and implement UI/UX for the ERP system's business modules.
Maintained and fixed bugs in the ERP system, improved user experience, and reduced errors occurring during use.
Reported work progress to management on a weekly basis.
Built client websites using PHP (WordPress), HTML, CSS, SASS, Bootstrap, jQuery (AJAX), and MySQL.
Developed reusable blocks/components with React to shorten delivery time and ensure consistent interfaces across projects.
Collaborated with the UI/UX team to convert designs into responsive interfaces.
Optimized websites for mobile devices using Media Queries and Bootstrap.
Supported clients with website hosting and domain pointing.
Maintained and fixed bugs in websites, and reported progress weekly.
Proactively researched new technologies outside working hours (React Native) to expand the department's technical capabilities, in line with the department head's direction.
Assembled computers according to customers' configurations and needs.
Installed Windows and software on request.
Inspected, diagnosed, and fixed hardware and software issues.
Supported customers at their offices in resolving computer problems.
Worked with colleagues to install and configure routers, switches, and LAN networks (including VLAN segmentation) for nearby businesses, with 50+ machines.
